facts.text: NKU says all performance venues have accessible seating; a house manager or usher can help. Guests who need special seating because of a medical condition should contact the box office at least 48 hours ahead; availability depends on the performance venue.
quote: All performance venues have handicap accessible seating . Please see a House Manager or Usher for assistance.

Guests requiring special seating consideration due to a medical condition should contact the Box Office to make advance arrangements with a minimum of 48 hours notice. Availability depends on the performance venue.

facts.text: Lots D and I are designated for SOTA events including music concerts, theatre/dance productions and gallery receptions. For student recitals, Henry Theatre productions and general gallery visits, the event policy instead directs visitors to the Welcome Center Garage. No food or drink is permitted in Fine Arts Center performance venues.
quote: Parking Lots D and I have been designated for NKU SOTA events, including music concerts, theatre & dance productions, and art gallery receptions.
If attending student recitals, productions in The Henry Theatre, or general art gallery visits, guests should use the Welcome Center Garage .
No food or drinks are permitted in any performance venue in the Fine Arts Center.
Corbett Theatre performances are reserved seating .
Stauss Theatre and Greaves Concert Hall performances are general seating .
Venues will open for seating approximately 30 minutes prior to curtain.
Due to seating arrangements and staging of Stauss Theatre, there is no late seating .

facts.quote: If guests do not have a mobile device or home printing capabilities, tickets can be checked in by box office staff.

facts.text: The Fine Arts Center has an adjacent cul-de-sac for drop-off and pick-up only, with no parking. The SOTA directions list a fee for Welcome Center Garage parking for student recitals/productions and general gallery visits. Curb transitions and the complete route from vehicle to entrance are not described.
quote: There is a cul-de-sac next to the Fine Arts Center available for drop-off and pick-up only . No parking.
Parking is available for a fee in the Welcome Center Garage for student recitals/productions and general gallery visits.

facts.text: NKU directs visitors into the Fine Arts Center through the row of glass doors, with Greaves Concert Hall immediately inside. For Corbett’s accessible entrance, turn right from Greaves lobby, go through the double doors, then look ahead and slightly right for another set of doors with ADA signs. Early arrivals should wait there for an usher; box-seat holders are directed to the second-floor entrance instead.
quote: Enter the Fine Arts Center at the row of glass doors; immediately inside these doors is Greaves Concert Hall.

Corbett Theatre Accessible Entrance
From Greaves lobby, turn Right and go straight until you pass through a set of double doors.
Ahead and slightly to the right you will see another set of double doors with ADA signs directing you to Corbett Theatre
If you arrive early, please wait here for an usher to assist you to your seats once the theatre is open for seating.
If you have Box Seats, please follow the above directions to the second floor for entry at the top of the theatre.

facts.text: For the Corbett Theatre upper entrance and box office, turn right from Greaves lobby and pass through the double doors; turn left to the elevator immediately on the left. Take it to floor 2, turn right, and continue to the hallway end; Corbett, the Community Showcase Atrium and box office are on the left. This is the upper entrance, not the separate signed accessible-seating entrance.
facts.quote:
Corbett Theatre / Box Office
From Greaves lobby, turn Right and go straight until you pass through a set of double doors.
Turn Left and there will be an elevator immediately on your Left.
Take the elevator to second floor.
Make a Right when you get off the elevator.
Go straight until hallway dead-ends
Corbett Theatre, the Community Showcase Atrium and the Box Office will be to your Left.

facts.text: To Stauss Theatre, NKU directs visitors right from Greaves lobby through double doors, then left along the long hallway to a right turn. Continue down that hallway past an elevator on the right to the Stauss lobby. Door controls, gradients and the route to an individual seat are not specified.
facts.quote:
Stauss Theatre
From Greaves lobby, turn Right go straight until you pass through a set of double doors.
Turn Left and follow the long hallway until you reach a hallway to turn right.
Turn Right down this hallway and continue straight ahead.
You'll pass an elevator on your right.
Straight ahead you will enter Stauss Theatre lobby.

facts.text: For the art galleries, turn right from Greaves lobby through double doors, then left to the elevator immediately on the left. Take it to floor 3, turn right to the hallway end, then make a sharp left toward the gallery-entrance hallway. The directions do not describe door controls or restroom access.
facts.quote:
Art Galleries
From Greaves lobby, turn Right go straight until you pass through a set of double doors.
Turn Left and there will be an elevator immediately on your Left.
Take the elevator to third floor.
Make a Right when you get off the elevator.
Go straight until hallway dead-ends.
Make a sharp Left and head towards the hallway where the gallery entrances are located.

facts.text: The SOTA box office is cashless and accepts credit cards only: Visa, MasterCard and Discover. American Express is not accepted. Arrange an accepted payment method before travel.
facts.quote:
Transactions are now cashless.
The box office accepts credit card payments only .
Visa, MasterCard, and Discover accepted. We do not accept American Express.

facts.text: SOTA lists live box-office assistance Tuesday and Thursday, noon–4 p.m., and physical opening one hour before ticketed events. Outside live hours, callers can leave voicemail at 859-572-5464 or email boxoffice@nku.edu; no callback time is promised.
quote: For phone orders or inquiries, please leave a voicemail at (859) 572-5464 and your call will be returned as soon as possible. Or email boxoffice@nku.edu with any other questions.

For live assistance , please visit or contact the box office during the following hours:
Tuesday Noon - 4 p.m.
Thursday Noon - 4 p.m.
The physical box office will also open one hour before ticketed events for any night of show needs.

facts.text: If NKU closes for inclement weather, scheduled performances that day are canceled. Guests may receive a refund or exchange to another date of the same production, subject to availability; the box office says it will contact guests and make every effort to announce cancellations through its voicemail, website and local media.
facts.quote:
If NKU closes due to inclement weather conditions, all scheduled performances on that day will be canceled.
If a performance is canceled, guests may receive a refund or exchange for another date of the same production, subject to availability.
Box office staff will call guests to make arrangements, or guests may also call the box office.
The box office will make every effort to alert guests in advance on its voice mail message, website, and local media if a performance is canceled.
